title: A Th17-centered immune network for tertiary lymphoid structure formation in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma after neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy.
publicationName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
journalName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
snippet: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy (NICT) benefits esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), yet underlying antitumor immunity remains elusive. This study aimed to dissect the cellular and molecular determinants and identify predictive biomarkers of NICT response in ESCC.
